paper_title: Constraints on axionlike particles with H.E.S.S. from the irregularity of the PKS 2155-304 energy spectrum
notes: H.E.S.S. constraint on ALP-photon coupling from spectral irregularity of PKS 2155-304 (z=0.116). Headline conservative limit g_gamma-a < 2.1e-11 GeV^-1 at 95% C.L. for ALP masses between 15 neV and 60 neV, derived assuming photon-ALP mixing in the galaxy cluster magnetic field (1 uG, 370 kpc, Lc=10 kpc). Encoded as flat two-point bound over stated mass range. Paper also quotes an optimistic IGMF-based limit ~5e-11 GeV^-1 near 1 neV mass (assuming 1 nG IGMF), not included since authors themselves label it optimistic and magnetic-field dependent. Full exclusion contours are only in Fig. 7 (not digitizable from text). Limits apply to both pseudoscalar and scalar bosons coupling to photons. Not a dark-matter search, so no local DM density assumption. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.8, 2))
